A Quote grows to hold its content: 3 rows at 3.265, 5 at 4.096, 5 at 4.927, 6 at 5.758.

scores.note: First round. The Source steps all missed under every rule: each predicted lines that Source does not make (10 steps). The 6 Quote steps:

refit1.rule: When the content grows, rows = the larger of the rows and ceil(x - 0.02). When it shrinks and ceil(x - 0.02) is under the rows, rows = floor(x + 0.02); otherwise they stay.
refit1.seen: Seen only, 7 of the 8 grow and shrink steps read so far (x from ours, which has the same boxes): 6 to 7 at 6.59 and 7 to 10 at 9.08 (grow); Quote emptied 10 to 3 and 6 to 3 at 3.27; 6 to 4 at 4.93; 4 stays at 4.10 and at 3.27. Miss: Source emptied after the long quote, 9.08 to 8.69, keeps 9 rows on the oracle; the rule gives 8. Our old rule (round up both ways) gives 4 of 8. Not fitted further: one round was asked for, and no rule tried fits all 8.
